key.description: Id of the external library generation operation.

filename.description: Name of the file containing the high code package.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the operation was created, in UTC

libraryKey.description: Key of the library generated from the high code package. Only available after status is ReadyForReview inclusive

libraryName.description: Name of the library generated from the high code package. Only available after status is ReadyForReview inclusive

libraryDescription.description: Description of the library generated from the high code package. Only available after status is ReadyForReview inclusive

libraryIconUri.description: Uri to be used to fetch the library's icon. This Uri will have an expiration time of 30 minutes

libraryUri.description: Uri to be used to fetch the library.

isNewLibrary.description: States if the external library was already published before. Only available after status is ReadyForReview inclusive

status.description: Status of the external library generation operation

OutSystems.ExternalLibraryGeneration.Ser.description: Status of a generation operation in the v1beta1 API
